items.title: [Remoto] Senior Front-end / Product Engineer (React/TypeScript) na WeatherWise — 4 dias / 32h
items.description:
## Descrição da vaga

**Semana de trabalho de 4 dias — 32 horas semanais.**
**Remuneração mensal: R$ 15.000 a R$ 25.000, conforme experiência.**

**Senior Front-end / Product Engineer (Design-led), reporting to the CTO.**

Design and build the interfaces through which brokers, insurers and contractors work with an agentic AI platform. Take problems from first sketch to shipped product: agent conversations, policy-structuring workbenches, risk dashboards and microsites.

There is no separate design team: you will own UX, visual design and implementation. Help humans understand what our agent Kite did and why, surface uncertainty, and make review, correction and approval clear and effective.

- Build React/TypeScript product interfaces, from information architecture to visual detail.
- Own the design system, component library and visual consistency.
- Turn weather and financial data into readable maps, time series, tables, payout curves and portfolio views.
- Use AI coding/design tools to prototype and iterate quickly.
- Run lightweight user research and work directly with the CEO, CTO and sales team.

Full role details: https://github.com/frontendbr/vagas/issues/8572

## Local

100% remoto — trabalhando permanentemente do Brasil com a equipe da WeatherWise, sediada em Londres.

## Benefícios

- Semana de trabalho de **4 dias / 32 horas semanais**.
- **100% remoto do Brasil**.
- Ownership of design direction and direct access to the CEO and CTO.
- A small senior team building production agentic products for real customers.

## Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:**
- 6+ years building production web applications, with deep fluency in React or a comparable modern framework and TypeScript.
- Work demonstrating ownership of UX, visual design and implementation, with clear explanations of design decisions.
- Strong data-visualisation skills: charts, maps and dense tables.
- Daily use of AI coding/design tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.
- Experience with AI/agent interfaces, or a credible explanation of how you would approach them.
- Ability to scope ambiguous problems and ship independently.

**Desejáveis:**
MapLibre, Mapbox, deck.gl, time-series visualisation at scale, B2B/fintech/insurtech products, design systems and an interest in climate or risk.

A portfolio or live work counts for more than a CV.

## Contratação

**PJ (Pessoa Jurídica). R$ 15.000 a R$ 25.000 por mês, conforme experiência. Jornada de 32 horas semanais em 4 dias.**

## Nossa empresa

WeatherWise (Ehabitation Ltd, trading as EHAB) is a London-based weather risk specialist. We help construction, energy, agriculture and logistics businesses understand, plan for and insure against weather risk.

We build WeatherWise Construction (weather-delay analysis) and WeatherWise Studio (AI-native parametric insurance). Our agent Kite helps brokers discover risks, structure and price cover, generate materials and route submissions to suitable carriers. A weather-data engine drawing on 180,000+ stations and global datasets powers both platforms. Trust, auditability and correctness matter. Website: https://www.ehab.co/

## Como se candidatar

Email **josh.graham@weatherwise.studio** with subject **Senior Front-end / Product Engineer**.

Skip the cover letter. Send 2–3 things you have built (links, a short Loom or a repo) plus a couple of sentences on what you would change now. We will come back to every application and aim to run the process from first conversation to offer in under three weeks.

## Labels

- 🏢 Remoto
- 👴 Sênior
- ⚖️ PJ
- 💰 15k+

We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you’re looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we’d love for you to join us on this journey.

 
Role Overview

This Frontend Engineer will be responsible for driving the development of intuitive, high-performance user interfaces that simplify how developers manage increasingly complex frontend applications. By consistently deploying user-friendly features and maintaining a high-quality codebase, this role ensures the delivery of performant products that directly enhance user satisfaction and align with our long-term strategic growth. We are looking for a resilient and autonomous professional with a proven track record in product-focused companies, specifically one who has experience working on core product features and thrives in highly collaborative environments alongside UX and Engineering teams. This role will report to the CTO.

Develop, deploy, and maintain scalable, responsive web applications using modern front-end technologies (focus on desktop with some mobile, which could evolve with time).
Collaborate with product managers and UX/UI designers to understand requirements, ensure its technical feasibility, and translate them into technical, user-friendly solutions.
Maintain and improve the company’s front-end codebase by refactoring legacy code and implementing best practices ensuring performance across multiple devices and browsers.
Participate in code reviews, ensuring best practices in front-end development.

Write reusable code and libraries for future use, optimizing components for maximum speed.
 

Requirements
Required Qualifications

Proven professional experience (3+ years) in front-end development, preferably in product-focused companies and working in complex projects alongside Product/UX/UI teams.
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, with expertise on React
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and working alongside back-end development teams.
Experience working with authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth, JWT, or SAML.

Experience working with modern async communication and documentation tools (e.g., Slack, Notion)
Ability to travel as needed to meet the team.
English - Advanced (Reading, Comprehension, and Writing).

Preferred Qualifications

Relevant hands-on experience with desktop-first products in a tech-intensive industry, such as dashboards featuring complex data visualizations and interactive charts
Experience with Vite, Webpack, Babel, and other build tools for optimizing front-end workflows.
Experience in building responsive layouts and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.
Experience with SSR-capable frameworks (eg., Next.js, Remix
Experience with secure data storage and handling sensitive information (e.g., encryption, tokenization).
Experience implementing secure front-end authentication/session patterns to protect user data, including proper input sanitization, secure JWT/cookie handling, safe browser storage choices and alignment with OWASP guidance.
Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth and fast-paced startup (or similar) environment.
